reader_notes: Convincing as a signed opinion piece by a driving instructor: first-person observation, a named source who pushes back, a concrete proposal at the end. The debattartikel voice is right for LÄS.
Q1 is clean arithmetic off the text (29 to 34 north of the school). C is properly refuted by the unchanged southern stretch and D by the Tunbergsvägen figure.

Q2 required holding two of the author's moves at once: she refuses a delay ('Jag begär ingen ny utredning, och jag tycker inte att nämnden ska vänta'), which kills A, and she argues the noise originates in braking and acceleration rather than in the rubber, which kills B. That leaves C and it is well earned.
The self-undercutting paragraph (Skedvall's three caveats, which the author concedes) is a nice authentic touch and makes the piece feel argued rather than asserted.
The closing offer to be proved wrong in April is a satisfying finish and does not create any second defensible reading of Q2.
